subject.title: fix(ui): split-view pane header opens a hidden session dropdown when clicked

question: Should split-view toolbar session switching be retired in favor of sidebar navigation and drag-and-drop, or should a visible non-drag-stealing switcher remain?
rationale: Current docs and current main treat toolbar session switching as a user-facing affordance, while this PR fixes the drag bug by deleting that affordance from the toolbar.

options.title: Retire Toolbar Switching And Update Docs
options.body: Keep the static header approach, but update user docs to describe sidebar navigation and drag-and-drop as the supported switching paths before merge.

options.title: Preserve A Visible Switcher
options.body: Replace the hidden full-width native select with a compact explicit control that does not occupy the titlebar drag strip.

recommendation.title: Retire Toolbar Switching And Update Docs
recommendation.body: Keep the static header approach, but update user docs to describe sidebar navigation and drag-and-drop as the supported switching paths before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the introducing split-toolbar PR and authored this protected maintainer-labeled PR, making him the best available owner for the UX contract choice.
